# `.iep` golden fixtures

Files here were written by the app's own `writeIep` and are committed once, per format version. They must
keep loading in every future version (docs/05 §2.3). Never regenerate or edit an existing fixture; add a new
one instead.

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `v1/two-layers.iep` | 300×200: white "Background" (id `bg`) and "Red dot" (id `dot`, opacity 0.5) with a 20×20 red square at (140,90). |
